title: Who should your Premier League club sign before the transfer deadline?
trail: Premier League teams have until 5pm on Thursday to bring in new players. Who should the club you support be targeting?
body: Premier League managers have a harder job than usual this summer. For once, they have to compile their squads before the season begins. Reducing the length of the transfer window seems very sensible: clubs have a few weeks to trade players and then, once the season kicks off, everyone can concentrate on football rather than finances, rumours and going on strike. But a few clubs are leaving it very late to finalise their squads. With that in mind, who should your club be targeting in the next few days? Tell us in the form below and we’ll feature a selection of your contributions on the site before the window edges closed.
